epics.title: Finish-review follow-ups (Phase 8.1 surfaces)
epics.description: The residue of the Phase 11 finish-reviewer runs (`.planning/phases/11-ship-it/11-FINISH-REVIEW.md`): findings that were recorded rather than fixed, and six design judgements filed as decisions. Source ids are the reviewer's row ids.
